Privacy note: this standalone demo stores telemetry in this browser only after consent. Phone numbers and exact GPS coordinates are not persisted in telemetry; saved coordinates are rounded to roughly 1 km. This is not a secure cross-device admin system. Production use requires authenticated backend storage, strict role checks, row-level security, retention controls and explicit location-consent handling.
